summary: Clean. Task 2 is frontend foundation only (shadcn-vue scaffolding, i18n key seeding, sidebar sub-nav, four empty page shells) with no business logic, no API calls, and no auth handling. Audited the hand-written attack surface: page shells, the sidebar sub-nav logic in default.vue, the new i18n values, and the package.json/lockfile delta. No XSS sinks (no v-html/innerHTML anywhere in added files — all interpolation is via mustache binding which Vue auto-escapes). No hardcoded secrets or credentials in the diff. The single new dependency vue-sonner@2.0.9 is the legitimate package (verified: lockfile integrity sha512-i6BokNlNDL93... matches the public npm registry entry for xiaoluoboding/vue-sonner, MIT, official repo) — not a typosquat. i18n values are plain static strings rendered through escaped t() interpolation, so they introduce no injection risk. Sidebar route paths are built from projectsStore.currentProject.id (server-sourced store state, not user-controlled free text) and the locale-prefix regex is anchored. No findings.
